Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    !IsBlank(LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).ProfilePhoto),
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).ProfilePhoto,
    SampleImage
)

If(
    ThisItem.Status.Value = "Completed",
    RGBA(40, 167, 69, 1),          // soft green
    Switch(
        ThisItem.Severity.Value,
        "High",   RGBA(236, 100, 75, 1),   // soft red
        "Medium", RGBA(255, 159, 64, 1),   // soft orange
        "Low",    RGBA(255, 205, 86, 1),   // soft yellow
        RGBA(200, 200, 200, 1)
    )
)

Switch(
    ThisItem.Severity.Value,
    "High",   RGBA(236, 100, 75, 1),   // soft red
    "Medium", RGBA(255, 159, 64, 1),   // soft orange
    "Low",    RGBA(255, 205, 86, 1),   // soft yellow
    RGBA(200, 200, 200, 1)             // fallback
)
